<a name="machinery-architecture"></a>
### Architecture and Layer Inventory

Format Factory uses 11 independent layers, each with defined responsibilities.

| Layer | Name | Purpose | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| L01 | Specification Authority Layer (SAL) | Extracts machine-readable facts from format specifications | 30 |
| L02 | QName Registry | Maps spec element names to canonical class names | 21 |
| L03 | Capability Layer | Tracks per-format capability status and gap ledger | 182 |
| L05 | Oracle Layer | Deterministic verification against spec-derived test cases | 83 |

| L07 | Test Layer | Unit, integration, roundtrip, and security tests | 12844 |
| L08 | Evidence Layer | Sprint evidence declarations and review packages | (gitignored local state) |
| L09 | State Layer | Continuation signals, plan locks, action queues | (gitignored local state) |
| L11 | Supervisor Layer | Autonomous sprint orchestration and grading | 647 |
| L12 | Governance Layer | Programmatic governance enforcement (validators) | 35 |
| L13 | Skills Layer | Registered skill catalog and command routing | 154 |

<a name="machinery-limitations"></a>
### Machinery Limitations

- **LAYER_DEFINITIONS is hardcoded** in `generate_architecture_inventory.py` — layer paths are not derived from a registry. Adding a new layer requires updating the constant manually.
- **L08/L09 file counts** are gitignored local state — counts vary by machine and session; not meaningful for cross-machine comparison.
- **Governance validator runner** is not integrated into pre-commit hooks for all validators — only a subset are enforced at commit time.

<a name="known-limitations"></a>
## Known Limitations

### Machinery Limitations

- **LAYER_DEFINITIONS is hardcoded** in `generate_architecture_inventory.py` — not derived from a registry. Manual update required when adding layers.
- **L08/L09** are gitignored local state; file counts vary by machine.
- **Checkpoint interval** is not configured in `.supervisor/policies.yaml`.

### Product Limitations

- **Formats without source** (30): CSV, DIF, FODS, GNUMERIC, ODS, SYLK, TSV, ABW, FODT, ODT, FODP, FODG, ORA, PAM, PBM, PGM, PPM, QOI, XCF, XPM, IPYNB, NDJSON, TOML, ZPAQ, ZST, MTLX, NRRD, SAFETENSORS, UBL, XLIFF (no product_track)
- **PyPI publication**: All Python packages are local-only; not published to PyPI

### Release Limitations

- **Commercial .NET release**: Gate 11 execution approval pending (Babar Raza)
- **External users**: No external users yet; all testing is internal
